source.title: Seeking motivation and reward: Roles of dopamine, hippocampus, and supramammillo-septal pathway.

confidence_rationale: Authoritative review that makes exactly the claim H-approach-primitive needs -- that exploratory and curiosity-driven behaviour occurs in the absence of a clear goal or reward and is regulated by an INNATE drive with identified substrates -- and reframes phasic dopamine as signalling potentially-important stimuli rather than reward. Its status as a review with an explicit theoretical proposal (environment prediction error) rather than a single decisive experiment caps the confidence.
failure_signatures: This is a review advancing a framework, not a decisive experiment; the 'innate drive' claim is a synthesis position and there are competing accounts that fold information-seeking back into reward learning as an intrinsic bonus.

'Environment prediction error' as the currency means the drive is still error-driven, just against a world-model rather than a reward-model -- so it is not obviously non-extinguishing; a well-modelled environment would quiesce it, which is the opposite of what H-approach-primitive requires for a cold-start.
The review does not address whether such a drive is SUFFICIENT to bootstrap competence absent a demonstrator; it addresses whether it exists and what implements it.

mapping.source_claim_statement: Curiosity and exploratory behaviour occur in the absence of a clear goal or reward and have long been argued to be regulated by an innate drive. The supramammillary-to-hippocampal pathway carries the cognitive component (salience, uncertainty); supramammillary glutamatergic -> medial septal glutamatergic -> VTA dopaminergic projections set its vigour. Phasic dopamine signals potentially important stimuli rather than rewards.
mapping.ree_translation: The 'SEEKING'-type appetitive drive is not a metaphor: it has an identified anatomical implementation distinct from the reward-prediction-error machinery, and it sets the VIGOUR of exploration independently of experienced reward. For CDQ-007 this supports the possibility that REE's converter is missing a drive channel that biology keeps architecturally separate from the critic.
mapping.mapping_caveat: A review, so the evidence is synthesised rather than generated. More importantly, the proposed currency is ENVIRONMENT prediction error -- which means the drive quiesces as the world-model improves. That is a meaningfully different object from the non-extinguishing drive H-approach-primitive posits, and the difference must not be elided when mapping.
mapping.source_context: Review of rodent and human literature on curiosity, exploration and information-seeking; hypothalamic-hippocampal-VTA circuitry.

confidence_components.notes: High-quality review in a strong venue making the exact architectural claim at issue, but review status plus the environment-prediction-error framing (which is error-driven, hence extinguishable) keep it moderate.
